scope: Vertical-plane monocular integration, level hull with surge/heave; known side standoff and plane prior; reused training photo appearance; no real-vehicle/general 3D validation
timing: 30 Hz fixed simulated time; measured inference latency not injected

config.camera_mount: fixed side-looking, upright; optical axis toward the declared vertical inspection plane
config.assumptions: Side mount, known perpendicular observation distance, ideal pressure depth/odometry and vertical-plane prior are explicit simulation assumptions. Heave limits are assumed, not measured BlueROV2 performance. Hull stays level; zero surge during ascent/descent is not zero route speed. No pitch actuator, seabed, pressure or tether physics.

camera_reference_profile.name: BlueROV2 planar inspection reference with 4K Cam
camera_reference_profile.scope: Published hardware references plus explicit uncalibrated planar simulation assumptions

published_vehicle.usage: Dimensional and propulsion reference, not a deep-sea pressure-rating claim

camera.model: Blue Robotics 4K Cam (wide setting, nominal pinhole)
camera.published_delay_test_setup: 1080p30 on 2024 M3 MacBook Air; not direct inference-input delay

simulation.delay_usage: Stress proxy only; do not equate display latency with measured camera-to-inference delay

assumption_notes: No calibrated lens distortion, housing refraction, current compensation or tether drag
Planar surge/yaw only; published lateral/heave abilities are not fully implemented
Stopping surge is not verified station keeping
Hydrostatic depth, pressure and lighting physics are not simulated

camera_mount_override: Fixed side-looking upright; original 45-degree downward camera mounting is not used in this opt-in mode
coordinate_convention: World X forward, world Y lateral, pressure depth positive down; initial pipe depth is an evaluation-only datum
truth_access: Renderer and scorer only; controller receives predicted masks/RGB and measured X/depth odometry
